"""Own visual-servo controller for the live VLABench insert_flower episode."""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

LAYOUT = [
    "joint1_pos", "joint2_pos", "joint3_pos", "joint4_pos", "joint5_pos", "joint6_pos", "joint7_pos",
    "joint1_vel", "joint2_vel", "joint3_vel", "joint4_vel", "joint5_vel", "joint6_vel", "joint7_vel",
    "finger1_pos", "finger2_pos", "tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z", "tcp_qw", "tcp_qx", "tcp_qy", "tcp_qz",
]
LIMITS = np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-0.0698],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-0.0175,3.7525],[-2.8973,2.8973]])


def state(robot):
    res = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    p = res.meta["proprio"]
    return dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))


def q_and_pose(s):
    q = np.array([s[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1,8)], dtype=float)
    p = np.array([s["tcp_x"],s["tcp_y"],s["tcp_z"]], dtype=float)
    quat = np.array([s[f"tcp_q{c}"] for c in "wxyz"], dtype=float)
    quat /= np.linalg.norm(quat)
    return q,p,quat


def command(robot, q, fingers=(0.04,0.04), steps=1, note=""):
    row = np.r_[np.asarray(q,dtype=float), np.asarray(fingers,dtype=float)]
    actions = np.repeat(row[None,:], int(steps), axis=0)
    res = robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.1, interpolate="hold", cameras=[], video="none", note=note)
    p = res.meta["proprio"]
    return dict(zip(p["layout"],p["now"])), res.meta


def quat_conj(q):
    return np.array([q[0],-q[1],-q[2],-q[3]])


def quat_mul(a,b):
    aw,ax,ay,az=a; bw,bx,by,bz=b
    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])


def rotvec(q):
    q=np.asarray(q,dtype=float); q=q/np.linalg.norm(q)
    if q[0]<0: q=-q
    v=q[1:]; nv=np.linalg.norm(v)
    return np.zeros(3) if nv<1e-10 else v*(2*np.arctan2(nv,q[0])/nv)


def jacobian(robot, base, probe=0.025):
    """Empirical TCP spatial Jacobian from small, reversible joint probes."""
    q0,p0,quat0=q_and_pose(base)
    J=np.zeros((6,7))
    for j in range(7):
        direction=1.0 if q0[j]+probe < LIMITS[j,1]-0.003 else -1.0
        qt=q0.copy(); qt[j]+=direction*probe
        s1,_=command(robot,qt,steps=4,note=f"jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
        q1,p1,quat1=q_and_pose(s1)
        dq=q1[j]-q0[j]
        if abs(dq)<1e-4:
            command(robot,q0,steps=4,note="restore after small probe")
            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} probe did not move")
        delta_rot=rotvec(quat_mul(quat1,quat_conj(quat0)))
        J[:,j]=np.r_[p1-p0,delta_rot]/dq
        s2,_=command(robot,q0,steps=4,note=f"restore joint {j+1} probe")
        base=s2
    return J,base


def solve_step(J, pos_error, rot_error=None, max_joint=0.10):
    if rot_error is None: rot_error=np.zeros(3)
    # Scale angular motion to a similar task-space weight as metres.
    scale=0.16
    Jw=np.vstack([J[:3],scale*J[3:]])
    e=np.r_[pos_error,scale*rot_error]
    lam=0.02
    dq=Jw.T@np.linalg.solve(Jw@Jw.T+lam*lam*np.eye(6),e)
    peak=np.max(np.abs(dq))
    if peak>max_joint: dq*=max_joint/peak
    return dq


def main():
    robot=Robot()
    print("episode",robot.status())
    s=state(robot)
    q,p,quat=q_and_pose(s)
    print("start q",np.round(q,4),"tcp",np.round(p,4),"quat",np.round(quat,4))
    J,s=jacobian(robot,s)
    print("local J position (m/rad):\n",np.round(J[:3],4))
    print("local J rotation (rad/rad):\n",np.round(J[3:],4))
    print("after calibration",robot.status())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
